phaseConvention: Normalized phase0 Right initial strike; .5 Left initial strike; increasing phase always forward. Loop endpoint1=0.
landmarkCoordinates: Native glTF model-space. Derive foot local by subtracting original Foot bind position, Toe local by subtracting revised Toe bind position; all bind rotations identity. Unity mirrors X.
hipsSway: Cyclic bounded X ±.01m; Root position fixed. Do not strip this cosmetic sway.
